'''''CMA CGM Antoine de Saint Exupery''''' is a [[container ship]] that is operated by French shipping company [[CMA CGM]].  As the lead ship of her [[Antoine de Saint Exupery-class container ship|class]], she is the flagship of CMA CGM's fleet.

Named after the [[Antoine de Saint-Exupéry|French author and aviator]], ''CMA CGM Antoine de Saint Exupery'' was ordered in April the 1st 2015 as the first of three sister ships from [[Hanjin Heavy Industries and Construction Philippines]].<ref name="ml">{{cite web|date=27 January 2018|title=CMA CGM takes delivery of 20,600 TEU boxship from HHI-Phil|url=http://www.marinelog.com/index.php?option=com_k2&view=item&id=28211:cma-cgm-takes-delivery-of-20600-teu-boxship-from-hhi-phil&Itemid=231|publisher=Marine Log|accessdate=20 February 2018}}</ref>  It was launched in August 2017, and after fitting out underwent sea trials in late December 2017 and early January 2018.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://worldmaritimenews.com/archives/239793/hhic-phil-sends-20600-teu-cma-cgm-newbuild-to-sea-trials/ | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180105084006/https://worldmaritimenews.com/archives/239793/hhic-phil-sends-20600-teu-cma-cgm-newbuild-to-sea-trials/ | url-status=usurped | archive-date=5 January 2018 | title=HHIC-Phil Sends 20,600 TEU CMA CGM Newbuild to Sea Trials | publisher=World Maritime News | date=5 January 2018 | accessdate=20 February 2018}}</ref>  She was delivered to CMA CGM on 25 January 2018, ahead of her entry into service on 6 February on a routing from southeast Asia to northern Europe.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://worldmaritimenews.com/archives/241932/cma-cgm-takes-delivery-of-its-largest-boxship/ | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180220092329/https://worldmaritimenews.com/archives/241932/cma-cgm-takes-delivery-of-its-largest-boxship/ | url-status=usurped | archive-date=20 February 2018 | title=CMA CGM Takes Delivery of Its Largest Boxship | publisher=World Maritime News | date=26 January 2018 | accessdate=20 February 2018}}</ref>

''CMA CGM Antoine de Saint Exupery'' measures 217,673 [[gross tonnage|gross tons]], and is 400m long, with a beam of {{convert|59|m|ft}} and a draft of {{convert|16|m|ft}} .<ref name="ml"/><ref name="cma cgm">{{cite web | url=http://www.cma-cgm.com/the-group/activities/shipping/vessel/9776418/cma-cgm-antoine-de-saint-exupery | title=CMA CGM Antoine de Saint Exupery | publisher=CMA CGM | accessdate=20 February 2018}}</ref>  She is powered by a [[Winterthur Gas & Diesel]] model [[Winterthur Gas & Diesel X92|X92]] low speed diesel engine, with a power output up to {{convert|73,560|kW|hp}} that can propel her at up to 22 knots (25 mph or 40 km/h).<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.motorship.com/news101/ships-and-shipyards/cma-cgm-takes-delivery-of-wingd-powered-flagship | title=CMA CGM takes delivery of WinGD-powered flagship | publisher=The Motorship | date=29 January 2018 | accessdate=20 February 2018}}</ref>  She has a capacity of 20,954 [[Twenty-foot equivalent unit|TEUs]].<ref name="cma cgm"/>
